purpose: Teach: 菅野/岩国/西宮/さいたま/前川/河村/鎌田/北川

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、新任の菅野部長を歓迎しろ
lines.en: I want you to welcome our new director, Sugano.
lines.style: Measured authority. Short, decisive sentences. Eyes forward. Each instruction lands with quiet weight—no performance, just the tone of someone used to being obeyed.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。山口県岩国の工場の状況を確認します
lines.en: Understood. I'll confirm the status of our factory in Iwakuni, Yamaguchi.
lines.style: Attentive, slightly formal. Immediate assent—no hesitation. Clear, steady delivery. The tone of someone taking detailed notes, already thinking ahead to execution.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、兵庫県西宮の支店を強化しろ
lines.en: Strengthen our branch in Nishi-Nomiiya, Hyogo.
lines.style: Direct assignment. Clipped, efficient. The same weight and brevity as before. No elaboration needed—he trusts the listener understands.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。さいたま市の研究施設の進捗を確認します
lines.en: Understood. I'll check on the progress of our research facility in Saitama.
lines.style: Calm confirmation. Matter-of-fact, methodical. A slight uptick at the end—already mentally cataloging the next task. No wasted motion in the delivery.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、新任の前川主任にプロジェクトを任せろ
lines.en: Entrust Maekawa, our new supervisor, with the project.
lines.style: Clear delegation. Steady tempo. A brief pause after the name—letting it land. Still in control, still composed. The tone of delegating to someone he trusts.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。経理の河村様に決算を依頼します
lines.en: Understood. I'll request the fiscal close-out from Kawamura in accounting.
lines.style: Measured agreement. Specific and professional. A touch more detail than the previous line—names matter here. Steady eye-contact level delivery.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、技術の鎌田様に新製品設計を任せろ
lines.en: Assign Kamada from the technical team to design the new product line.
lines.style: Final directive. Slightly slower than before—this one carries weight. The opening word carries conviction. Composed, but with an edge of finality.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。法務の北川様に契約書確認を依頼します
lines.en: Understood. I'll ask Kitagawa from legal to review the contracts.
lines.style: Closing confirmation. Quieter than the others—almost a verbal period on the exchange. Respectful, efficient, the tone of someone ending a meeting knowing everything has been understood and assigned.
